title: Video generation joins the prompt route
summary:
Preview video generation arrived alongside richer chat controls, a December news banner, and clearer community-focused docs.

Preview support for Veo 3.1 Fast and Seedance adds MP4 output, with image-to-video input for Seedance. Requests can set duration, aspect ratio, and audio; Enter also adds per-second video pricing information.

The chat app adds session controls for the system prompt and generation settings, renders charts in messages, and puts streamed reasoning in a collapsible panel. Sidebar and layout changes make those controls easier to reach.

A dismissible December news banner lists Pollen tiers and featured models. A link beneath GitHub sign-in invites votes on other login providers; neither change alters account balances or sign-in options.

highlights.title: Veo and Seedance video
highlights.text: Generate preview MP4 videos with `veo` or `seedance`; Seedance also accepts an image to animate. Set `duration`, `aspectRatio`, and `audio` on the prompt route. [Browse Veo](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=veo).

highlights.title: Charts and controls in chat
highlights.text: Adjust the system prompt and generation settings for a chat session, view charts in messages, and expand streamed reasoning when you want to inspect it. [Explore chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).
